approval_boundary: Restart authorizes final review and demonstrated schema-only repairs. Exact final freeze requires a later human approval of the reviewed head. Old J26-J28 standing approval is not applicable.
candidate_write_boundary: One Builder only, after exact-head REPAIR_AUTHORIZED and successful CAS lease; product-schema/** and narrowly necessary schema-only test tooling only. Keep canonical CI strict/read-only.
review_evidence_boundary: Reviewer/Security candidate worktrees are throwaway and read-only to the canonical branch. Durable evidence may be written to each role's own docs/schema-v1-evidence/<head>/<role>/ paths on ops/chatgpt-work-factory-v1 and issue #50.
forbidden: Gate A or Gate B implementation
idle_behavior: silent no-op; resume existing checkpoint, do not repeat unchanged reviews
completion_behavior: Pause Reviewer/Security/Builder at approval handoff or human-only blocker. Supervisor remains a silent approval watcher. Disable all schema roles on verified completion or mandate revocation.
